statement: Intent/requirements define the desired direction; reality outranks narrative, while observations remain mediated evidence rather than reality itself.
title: Reality precedence + measurement humility

source_name: Composition before invention without legacy worship
statement: Search live owners, ancestry, and lawful compositions before adding primitives. Incumbency does not create permanent entitlement when an explicit transfer or replacement is the smaller causal correction.
title: Composition before invention, without legacy worship

statement: Among designs that satisfy active obligations, minimize incidental causal and maintenance burden while preserving the credible trajectory. Several incomparable minima can be lawful.
title: Minimum Sufficient Embodiment

statement: Do not design normal operation at the failure edge. Treat ~20% as a default planning challenge only where a scalar percentage model is meaningful; qualify actual headroom with evidence and keep reserve classes/correlation explicit.
title: Operating envelope + typed reserve

source_name: Price option value against carrying and lock-in costs
statement: Preserve future seams only when their expected value—including later migration/irreversibility cost—pays their current complexity cost.
title: Price option value against carrying and lock-in costs

statement: Prefer singular logical ownership where one owner suffices; replicated/partitioned/migration authority must expose reconciliation, currentness, and cutover or conflict semantics.
title: Explicit authority topology

statement: For consequential guarantees, use witnesses that answer the assurance question without gratuitously rebuilding the whole operation. Independence, coverage, false-positive/negative costs, placement, and authority must be argued.
title: Narrow discriminative witnesses

statement: Descriptive, verification, selection, veto, monitoring, and audit roles are not interchangeable.
title: Witness placement and authority are part of the guarantee

statement: Semantic honesty, information scent, ownership/effect/ lifecycle legibility, host/domain fluency, change behavior, and expert craft matter separately from executable correctness. Professional appearance alone has no authority.
title: Authorship is an engineering plane

statement: Continue the project's engineering grammar, not every incumbent abstraction. Concentrate authorial novelty where semantics are genuinely novel.
title: Coherent authorship preserves novelty escape

statement: Human/AI descendant quality is relative to model/tool version, context, task population, expertise population, repository state, and time.
title: Generative quality carries evaluator currentness

statement: Names, types, comments, reports, and tests should not imply a stronger current guarantee than the artifact establishes.
title: Source signals carry semantic burden

statement: The immediate request selects emphasis but does not erase standing safety, security, durability, compatibility, custody, contractual, or other active obligations.
title: Quality is consequence- and obligation-relative

statement: Reviewer count, axis diversity, and evidence independence are distinct; none substitutes automatically for the others.
title: Diversity of failure axes and evidence sources

statement: Procedure must have a live causal job—epistemic, safety, attribution, reproducibility, auditability, custody, compliance/fairness, reviewability, or continuity—not ceremonial existence.
title: Procedure serves explicit obligations

statement: Exact inheritance requires logical sufficiency; bounded probabilistic claims may rely on calibrated evidence with an explicit error model.
title: Exact proof and probabilistic evidence are different claim classes

statement: A verifier should not silently contaminate its specimen and must test required membership/completeness where the claim depends on a selected set.
title: Verification preserves evidentiary conditions and completeness

statement: Read occurrence, locator, retained bytes, replayability, and as-of-checkpoint freshness are different strengths.
title: Continuity has replay classes and checkpoint scope

statement: Passing known scars and mutations does not establish unknown-failure robustness; renew attack axes when broader claims are made.
title: Hostile survival is bounded evidence

statement: Disposable spikes may trade polish for learning speed, but persistence, dependents, example/training use, or promotion trigger the relevant authorship and engineering gates.
title: Research roughness requires quarantine or requalification

statement: Keep uncertainty explicit while permitting authorized, reversible, observable, bounded-consequence actions that buy information. Irreversibility raises the qualification burden.
title: UNKNOWN does not require paralysis

statement: Use host-native representations internally; do not let local idiom silently change wire, ABI, schema, persistence, or interchange semantics.
title: External contracts constrain host-native lowering

source_name: Preserve scar evidence, not dead machinery
statement: Keep the discriminator, regression, provenance, or rationale needed to prevent recurrence; obsolete implementation needs a current job to remain.
title: Preserve scar evidence, not dead machinery by default

source_name: Time as cause distinct from time as epistemic proxy
statement: Time may be a real causal/contractual variable; elapsed time alone does not establish truth or staleness.
title: Time as cause is distinct from time as epistemic proxy

source_name: Optimize within the admissible set; doctrine is not a scalarizer
statement: Admissibility constraints and standing obligations define admissibility. Defaults and optimization pressures operate inside that region. When lawful choices remain Pareto-incomparable, expose the tradeoff rather than fabricating a total order.
title: Optimize within the admissible set
